prompt:
Remake the attached Vibe-Coding Center educational comic for its website, as a finished landscape 3:2 or 4:3 comic with FOUR equal panels in a 2 by 2 grid, read top-left to bottom-right. Retain the expressive hand-inked editorial comic style and practical educator workplace setting. Restyle in deep navy, steel blue, silver-gray, cool white with realistic warm skin tones. Keep a small safe margin on all edges. Exactly two distinct adults in each panel: the SAME slim man in his mid-to-late fifties, with a completely bald scalp, neat salt-and-pepper full beard, and blue cardigan; and a woman educator colleague. Use varied women of different appearances across panels. The man listens with hands down in panels 1, 3 and 4. The woman visibly points to or demonstrates the work and is the ONLY speaker in panels 1, 3 and 4. In panel 2 the man points at the laptop and is the ONLY speaker while the woman listens. One speech balloon per panel and its tail must point very clearly to the speaking person's mouth. Set exact large English text, with strong dark-on-light contrast. No extraneous small text or gibberish.
At top, two lines: “Vibe-Coding Center” and “Four Checks Before You Share”.
Top left panel heading “1. Education Privacy”. WOMAN says “Collect only what students need to share.” She points to a simple anonymous exit-ticket form on a laptop. The man listens.
Top right panel heading “2. Security”. BALD BEARDED MAN says “Keep keys private. Test who can get in.” He points at a laptop with a shield and key symbol. The woman listens.
Bottom left panel heading “3. Web Design”. WOMAN says “Make the learning task easy to find.” She demonstrates a clear, simple classroom activity on a tablet. The man listens.
Bottom right panel heading “4. Vibe-Code Rescue”. WOMAN says “Reproduce the bug. Fix it and test again.” She demonstrates the repair using a laptop and a short checklist with visual check marks. The man listens.
Only text in artwork is title, four headings and four speech balloons specified above. Aim for a finished, clean, warm educator-facing comic with obvious panel boundaries, clear faces, and readable type in a reduced web preview.
